summary.text: Easton Retzke is the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 89 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing unopposed from the May 5 primary.
According to Ballotpedia, he holds a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University (2025).

paragraphs.text: Retzke graduated from Sandusky High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 2025.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his background in political science and history shaped his commitment to public service.

He listed his campaign priorities as economic opportunity supporting local industries, affordable housing, fair funding for K-12 public education, and transparency in government spending and decision-making.

sources.title: Easton Retzke, Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
